public_identity.clearance_summary: Exact-name internet, indexed software/company, package-registry, account, and automated trademark searches found no indexed CollectiGen product match on 2026-07-20. A corrected official RDAP check found that collectigen.com has been registered since 2025-10-05 and is not project-owned, so the project will not claim or depend on that domain. The private TagManager repository name and tag-manager compatibility identifiers are not presented as the public mark. The user reviewed the documented limits of the screening and approved CollectiGen for public use without making outside legal clearance or domain/handle ownership a release requirement. Optional professional clearance remains a risk-reduction measure, not a completed legal opinion or release gate.

bundled_runtime.name: PySide6_Essentials
bundled_runtime.license: LGPL-3.0-only or GPL-3.0-only by bundled Qt module, plus third-party terms
bundled_runtime.notes: CollectiGen imports only Qt Core, GUI, and Widgets, but the unmodified Essentials wheel also conveys other Qt modules, including GPL-only Lottie, QML Compiler, and Quick Timeline binaries. Because the official wheel omits Qt's build-time SBOM, the package combines an exact wheel-RECORD-owned binary inventory with a conservative appendix containing every Qt 6.11.2 upstream attribution record and unique source LICENSES text; this may over-attribute and does not assert undocumented build flags.
